## Checklist

- [ ] I have read [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests have been added or updated and pass locally (`pytest`).
- [ ] `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` pass (or `pre-commit run --all-files`).
- [ ] `mypy pixelquery/` passes.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` in the appropriate
      category (`Added`, `Changed`, `Fixed`, `Deprecated`, `Removed`, `Security`).
- [ ] Public API changes have updated docstrings and/or README/examples.
- [ ] No new top-level runtime dependency was added without prior discussion
      in an issue.
